title: After Cmd-Q (Keep) and reopen with a browser page (focused text field) focused: plain keys typed after the restored page loaded reach it (cycle A); plain keys typed as soon as the main window is listed reach it, in order (cycle B)
why: Diagnostic for reopen-f4 (lead STATUS 6493, review of #32207): reopen-browser-first-key cycle 4 loses every plain key typed at once after the reopen. Cycle A tells whether plain keys reach the restored page at all; cycle B is the same check as cycle 4. Set-up clicks the field first: in a fresh app (no quit yet) real plain keys did not reach a page just loaded from the address bar (exploratory 9f0c6ff56af, both builds; journal: responder windowOrNone suppressed). Keys are CuaDriver desktop keys: on the minis this driver may not post events (CGPreflightPostEventAccess false in every reopen record), so CGEventPost keys and clicks were dropped with no error at e694efa.
